title: Generate an SBOM with Syft and Scan It with Grype
description: Produce CycloneDX and SPDX bills of materials for a container image, scan the SBOM with Grype, gate on fixable findings only, and compare the SBOM scan with a direct image scan.

steps.title: Step 1: generate the SBOM in two formats
Step 2: scan the SBOM with Grype
Step 3: a gate that fails on what you can fix
Step 4: compare with a direct image scan
